parsed.explanation: Restored Mac Roman misreadings of UTF-8: √ü to ß (Augustiner-Gaß), √∂ to ö (schönen, Frantzösischer). Corrected the resulting place Jenä to Jena and format 4tò to 4to, and the OCR format 8v6 to 8vo. Repaired the broken start tag <TITLE= to <TITLE> and escaped the bare ampersand as &. Uncertain readings (IT. Tomes, Lipf., fct.) were left unchanged; no format was invented where the notice gives none.
